# Authorization Checklist: Live hub garage-channel rules from capabilities

**Purpose**: Validate the quality of the authorization requirements for the capability-derived garage-channel kind rules (ST-574).
**Created**: 2026-10-07
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Is every garage role the hub serves (owner, receptionist, mechanic) given an explicit rule for mapped and for unmapped kinds? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, §FR-003]
- [x] CHK002 Are the unmapped garage kinds (`garage.messaged`, `garage.reported`, `garage.warned`, `garage.slots_changed`) stated to keep today's default (open for owner and receptionist, closed for a mechanic) rather than left implicit? [Gap, Spec §Assumptions] — resolved: Spec FR-002/FR-003 and the unmapped-kind assumption cover "a kind in no family"; example list added to the Assumptions.
- [x] CHK003 Is the mechanic's `can_record_final_price` right stated as mapping to no family, with the reason? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK004 Is the order of checks (feature switch, staff membership, then the table) written as a requirement and not only as plan prose? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, plan §allows()]
- [x] CHK005 Is "kind family" defined precisely enough (prefix vs exact name) to decide `booking.moved` and `booking.move_lapsed`? [Ambiguity, Spec §Clarifications]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK006 Do the receptionist's withheld kinds in FR-002, Story 2 and the Spec Delta agree with the capabilities the receptionist lacks in the capability table (`garage.reviews`, `garage.profile`, `garage.team`, `garage.prices`, `garage.feature_switches`)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, §FR-002]
- [x] CHK007 Does the spec's use of "owner" agree with the role name used by the capability table and hub (`garage`)? [Conflict, Spec §FR-002] — resolved: a Key Entities note now says "owner" is the `garage` role.

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK008 Is the removed-member case (still holding a stream after losing staff status) stated to hear nothing, including for kinds in no family? [Edge Case, Spec §Clarifications, §FR-002]
- [x] CHK009 Is a future table row that would open the garage channel to every mechanic (`garage.own_jobs`, `garage.audit_history`) guarded by a stated requirement? [Gap, plan §allows()] — resolved: spec Edge Cases now requires the disjointness test to also reject families naming those capabilities.
- [x] CHK010 Is the receptionist's receipt of a withheld kind through a `public:` key (event also public) stated as unchanged? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
